label: Sponsored

leaderboard.name: Top banner
leaderboard.placement: Below the header, above the breadcrumb. Site-wide on ad-eligible pages.
leaderboard.targeting: Run of site, or by section (providers, guides, compare)

margin.name: Margin skyscrapers
margin.placement: Left and right page margins, sticky, outside the 1200px content column. Only on screens 1560px and wider.
margin.targeting: Run of site, sold as a pair

billboard.name: Billboard
billboard.placement: Between sections on the home and country index pages.

inarticle.name: In-article banner
inarticle.placement: Mid-article on guides, between H2 sections. Never inside a table or the comparison block.
inarticle.targeting: By country, industry, payment method or MCC

rail.name: Sidebar box
rail.placement: In the right-hand aside on profiles, category pages and reference pages. Sits below page facts, never above them.
rail.targeting: By service category or reference page

native.name: Sponsored listing
native.placement: In-feed provider row after the third organic result on listing and category pages. Same layout as a listing, clearly labelled.

anchor.name: Mobile anchor
anchor.placement: Fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones. Dismissible, hidden after close for the session.

policy: Every ad carries a visible Sponsored label and sits in its own bordered container, separate from organic content.
Ad links use rel="sponsored nofollow" and open the advertiser site directly. No tracking pixels in the wireframe.
Ads never change ranking, verdicts, ratings or the default sort. The How we rank page says so.
No ads inside comparison tables, search results ordering, forms or the match tool.
Conversion pages are ad-free: match, assist, for providers, advertise.
We only accept advertisers that hold the licences their product requires. Unlicensed or prohibited services are declined.
Every slot reserves its height before load so ads never shift the layout.
Verified profiles on the paid provider tier can remove competitor sidebar ads from their own profile.
